list.title: My lessons
list.deletedHint: Deleted lessons are kept for 30 days so you can restore them; after that they no longer appear here.
list.emptyDeleted: No lessons deleted in the last 30 days

action.publishBody: Publish "{{title}}"? Students will see it in the library right away.
action.unpublishBody: Remove "{{title}}" from the library? Students will no longer see it, but their progress is kept.
action.deleteBody: Delete "{{title}}"? The lesson is kept for 30 days so you can restore it.
action.restoreBody: Restore "{{title}}"? It comes back as a Draft; publish it again for students to see it.
action.publishPro: This lesson requires Pro: Free students see it but cannot study it.
action.publishFree: This lesson does not require Pro.
action.deletePublishedNote: This lesson is published: students will no longer see it; their progress is kept.
action.reasonInvalid: A reason is required, up to 500 characters
action.notPublishable: This lesson cannot be published yet
action.noSentences: The lesson needs at least 1 sentence.

form.title: Title
form.linkInvalid: Enter a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch or youtu.be)
form.titleTaken: This title already exists, enter another one

create.cardTitle: Create a lesson from a YouTube video
create.cardSubtitle: Paste an English video link. The system fetches the transcript, splits it into sentences and adds IPA; the lesson is saved as a Draft. Add translations yourself or ask AI later.
create.limits: English videos, public or unlisted, up to 15 minutes long.
create.started: Creating the lesson. Keep working, you will be notified when it is done.
create.alreadyCreating: This video is already being turned into a lesson, wait for it to finish.
create.working: Fetching the transcript and splitting sentences… {{elapsed}}
create.canLeave: You can leave this page, don't close the tab
create.done: Created "{{title}}" with {{count}} sentences (Draft). Translations are empty: type them or use Suggest.

detail.videoUnavailable: The video cannot be played right now (it may have been removed or made private). Lesson details and sentences are still shown.

info.title: Edit lesson details
info.proOnBody: This lesson is published: requiring Pro stops Free students from continuing it (their progress is kept). Choose "Confirm save" to continue.
info.proOffBody: This lesson is published: no longer requiring Pro lets Free students study it again. Choose "Confirm save" to continue.
info.linkLocked: The YouTube link cannot be changed; create a new lesson to use another video.

sentences.title: Edit sentences
sentences.fixErrors: Some sentences are invalid, nothing was saved. Fix the fields marked in red.
sentences.leaveBody: You have unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?
sentences.publishedNote: This lesson is published: students see the new content as soon as you save; scores and progress are kept.
sentences.timeHint: Timestamps use mm:ss.s (e.g. 00:12.5). The play button uses the values you typed, even before saving.
sentences.deleteBody: Delete this sentence? Its progress will no longer count and open reports about it can only be rejected. The change applies when you Save.

error.MinDuration: Segment must be at least 0.5 seconds
error.ExceedsVideo: Timestamp is past the end of the video

suggest.title: Suggest translation
suggest.desc: AI writes the Vietnamese translation for the chosen sentences (uses credit). Suggestions only fill the fields; review them, then press Save.
suggest.overwriteConfirm: Existing content in these cells will be replaced by the new suggestions.
suggest.missing_one: AI could not suggest {{count}} sentence; it was left unchanged.
suggest.missing_other: AI could not suggest {{count}} sentences; they were left unchanged.

errors.network: Connection lost, nothing was saved. Try again.
errors.LESSON_NOT_FOUND: Lesson not found (it may have been deleted).
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this lesson.
errors.LESSON_NOT_PUBLISHED: This lesson is no longer published.
errors.LESSON_ALREADY_DELETED: This lesson has already been deleted.
errors.LESSON_NOT_DELETED: This lesson has already been restored.
errors.LESSON_RESTORE_EXPIRED: This lesson was deleted more than 30 days ago and cannot be restored.
errors.LESSON_VIDEO_TAKEN: This video already has a lesson.
errors.LESSON_MUST_KEEP_SENTENCE: A published lesson must keep at least 1 sentence. Unpublish it first to remove all sentences.
errors.YOUTUBE_LINK_INVALID: This is not a valid YouTube video link
errors.LESSON_STRUCTURE_LOCKED: This lesson has been published before, so sentences can no longer be split.

workspace.timingHint: Type times as mm:ss.s, or press − / + to shift by 0.1 s.
workspace.hasErrors: Some fields are invalid, press Edit to see them.
workspace.hintTeacher: Click a sentence to listen. Press Edit to change the text, translation and timing; IPA is regenerated on save. All changes are saved at once from the bottom bar.
workspace.hintAdmin: Click a sentence to listen to its segment.
workspace.saveFirst: Save or discard sentence changes first
workspace.splitHint: Click the bar between two words to split there.
workspace.splitInvalid: Put the cursor inside the English sentence (both parts need text), then press Split.
workspace.structureLocked: This lesson has been published before, so sentences can no longer be split or merged; you can still edit content, timing or delete sentences.
